tw: Kron the gatekeeper keeps eight keys, but a goat eats the gate at eight.
twc: 门卫 Kron 管着八把钥匙，山羊却在八点把大门吃了。

tw: Four bees praise Kron for his raisin cake and raise him up off the floor.
twc: 四只蜜蜂表扬 Kron 的葡萄干蛋糕，把他抬离了地面。

tw: Kron sits in the middle of a giant pancake on the griddle, playing a little fiddle.
twc: Kron 坐在铁板上大煎饼的正中间，拉着一把小提琴。

tw: "No swimming!" groans the old toad, so Kron goes skimming on a slim boat.
twc: 老蟾蜍嚷着“禁止游泳！”，Kron 就坐细长小船在水面滑。

tw: Kron hums some time away under a plum tree till nine plums drop on his thumb.
twc: Kron 在李子树下哼了一阵歌，九颗李子掉在他拇指上。

tw: A hen sits in Kron's pen holder, holding ten old pens like eggs.
twc: 一只母鸡坐进 Kron 的笔筒，把十支旧笔当蛋孵。

tw: Kron rubs the rubbish bin, and a fish with a grin spins out with a dish.
twc: Kron 擦了擦垃圾桶，一条咧嘴笑的鱼端着盘子旋出来。
hint: 擦垃圾桶，擦出了神灯鱼。

tw: Kron's well-known bell song makes every dog in town bring a bone to his throne.
twc: Kron 的铃铛歌很出名，全城的狗都叼骨头来献给他。

tw: Kron tries to blow off the snow, but his cough blows off the snowman's nose.
twc: Kron 想吹掉雪，一咳嗽却把雪人的鼻子吹飞了。

tw: Kron opens a pea pod, and odd little peas nod at him, one by one.
twc: Kron 剥开一个豆荚，奇怪的小豆子一颗颗朝他点头。

tw: Kron's foam bullet hits a full bull, and the bull lets it bounce off his belly.
twc: Kron 的泡沫子弹打中一头吃饱的公牛，被牛肚子弹了回来。

tw: Kron wants to see the world, so he swirls round the sea in a curled teacup.
twc: Kron 想去见世面，结果坐着卷边茶杯在海上打转。

tw: Lost among ferns, Kron has to turn to a worm, and the worm points left.
twc: Kron 在蕨丛里迷了路，只好求助一条蚯蚓，蚯蚓指向左边。

tw: Kron is willing to blow the still windmill on the hill till it spins.
twc: Kron 愿意对着山上不动的风车一直吹，直到它转起来。

tw: Kron is medium height, so he rides a kite to reach the light at night.
twc: Kron 个子中等，于是夜里骑着风筝去够那盏灯。

tw: Kron does a modern dance in odd pants, and the ants join in by chance.
twc: Kron 穿着怪裤子跳现代舞，蚂蚁们碰巧也跟着跳。

tw: Kron's surprise pie starts to rise into the skies, twice its size.
twc: Kron 的惊喜派开始涨上天，涨到两倍大。

tw: A fly flies out of a trout's mouth, and Kron can only cry out, "Why?"
twc: 一只苍蝇从鳟鱼嘴里飞出来，Kron 只能大叫：“为什么？”

tw: A high heap of onions on the shelf makes Kron cry himself to sleep.
twc: 架子上高高一堆洋葱，熏得 Kron 哭着睡着了。
